scope: Existing I3 physical SC delivery timestamps plus I2 SC100 delivery reference; no COM/SWD, no new test, no CRC/raw/journal roundtrip rerun

hypothesis.statement: The remaining150k bottleneck is plausibly fixed foreground work per DATA128 and the associated CDC completion/publication turnover, not primarily the small increase in payload byte rate.
hypothesis.classification: One plausible engineering hypothesis, not a proven attribution to TIME/CPU/USB
support: 150k has observed first acquisition reason1 and queue high water8, without ADC/time/local fault; matching legacy136.
150k requires50% more DATA128 frames/s while observed full-frame wire bytes/s rise only2.606% relative to100k.
Runtime attempts one prepared TX operation per pass; preparation, ticket checks, clock observations and final commit accompany each frame.
Both307B and210B frames require whole remaining frame space; two210B frames still exceed FIFO384.
Successful100k tolerated larger observed host read gaps and a larger host raw queue; the failed150k does not show host disk overflow.
limits: No first-fault timestamp or per-phase sums in legacy136; step/tx maxima include different boundaries and are not mean CPU time.
The150k prefix includes post-fault draining; its slope is not sustained acquisition throughput.
CDC IN/NAK/URB timings and FIFO occupancy are absent. Cannot isolate MCU computation from host USB scheduling.
TIME indirect-MMIO cost reduction is a candidate implementation question for the firmware author; these files do not measure its share or guarantee success.
hypothesis.useful_next_scope: Consider reducing already-required fixed foreground TIME/MMIO dispatch cost while preserving every observation/barrier and error behavior; no host queue/polling change is justified by this evidence.

qualifications: Arithmetic assumes nominal Fs and observed full-frame lengths. COBS length can vary with content; I2 had117 full frames of306B.
One frame per USB transfer is a conditional reference, not observed transfer boundaries or packet counts.
Wire frames and pyserial reads are not USB packets. A 544B read is application batching.
Queue sample-time arithmetic excludes staging/CDC/DMA and is not guaranteed stall tolerance.

method.equality_evidence: Existing physical-analysis.json offline PASS and matching traffic SHA reused; CRC/raw equality and fresh Open not rerun.
method.extraction: Read saved <BdI> chunks, reconstruct COBS envelopes by direction, inspect header and DATA metadata only; timestamp frame when its terminating byte is returned in host read.
method.windows: First DATA completion through END completion, includes failure draining. Additional first27-frame spans compare equal delivered counts but still do not certify performance.
method.units: milliseconds of host time.monotonic read-return observations, not ADC clock or USB transaction timestamps
method.program:
import collections,hashlib,json,math,statistics,struct,sys
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/"host"))
from motortester.stream_wire import cobs_decode,HEADER,Kind
CHUNK=struct.Struct("<BdI")
files={}
def sha(p):
    raw=p.read_bytes();files[p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()]={"bytes":len(raw),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()};return raw
def stats(seq):
    seq=sorted(seq)
    if not seq:return None
    def q(p):
        v=(len(seq)-1)*p;a=int(v);b=min(a+1,len(seq)-1)
        return seq[a]+(seq[b]-seq[a])*(v-a)
    return {"n":len(seq),"min":seq[0],"median":q(.5),"p95":q(.95),"max":seq[-1],"mean":statistics.mean(seq)}
def dist(seq):return {str(k):v for k,v in sorted(collections.Counter(seq).items())}
out={}
for label,folder in [("I3_100k","build/v6i-board-02/100000"),("I3_150k","build/v6i-board-02/150000"),("I2_100k_delivery_only","build/v6i-board-01/100000")]:
    folder=ROOT/folder
    analysis=json.loads(sha(folder/"physical-analysis.json"))
    receipt=json.loads(sha(folder/"run/result.json"))
    raw=sha(folder/"run/traffic.bin")
    assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==analysis["original_files_sha256_before"]["%s/run/traffic.bin"%folder.name]
    assert analysis["offline_validation_status"]=="PASS"
    nonce=int(analysis["nonce_hex"],16)
    chunks=[];frames=[];buf=[bytearray(),bytearray()];pos=0
    while pos<len(raw):
        direction,stamp,count=CHUNK.unpack_from(raw,pos);pos+=CHUNK.size
        block=raw[pos:pos+count];pos+=count
        ci=len(chunks);chunks.append({"direction":direction,"stamp":stamp,"bytes":count,"data_frames":0})
        for b in block:
            if b:buf[direction].append(b);continue
            if not buf[direction]:continue
            encoded=bytes(buf[direction]);buf[direction].clear();decoded=cobs_decode(encoded)
            major,minor,kind,r1,n,r2,fn,seq,req=HEADER.unpack_from(decoded)
            if direction!=1 or fn!=nonce:continue
            f={"kind":kind,"stamp":stamp,"sequence":seq,"wire_bytes":len(encoded)+1,"chunk":ci}
            if kind==int(Kind.DATA):
                gen,config,first,count,res=struct.unpack_from("<IIQHH",decoded,24)
                f.update(first_index=first,samples=count);chunks[ci]["data_frames"]+=1
            frames.append(f)
    data=[f for f in frames if f["kind"]==int(Kind.DATA)]
    start=next(f for f in frames if f["kind"]==int(Kind.START_ACK))
    end=next(f for f in frames if f["kind"]==int(Kind.END))
    reads=[c for c in chunks if c["direction"]==1 and data[0]["stamp"]<=c["stamp"]<=end["stamp"]]
    gaps=[(b["stamp"]-a["stamp"])*1000 for a,b in zip(reads,reads[1:])]
    framegaps=[(b["stamp"]-a["stamp"])*1000 for a,b in zip(data,data[1:])]
    first27=data[:27]
    result={
      "probe_status":receipt["status"],"nonce":analysis["nonce_hex"],"nominal_fs_hz":analysis["requested_sample_rate_hz"],
      "record_host_seconds":receipt["record_wall_seconds"],"delivered_samples":sum(f["samples"] for f in data),"DATA_frames":len(data),
      "frame_lengths_bytes":dist(f["wire_bytes"] for f in data),"frame_sample_counts":dist(f["samples"] for f in data),
      "read_window":"first DATA completion read through END completion read, includes draining",
      "read_sizes_bytes":dist(c["bytes"] for c in reads),"read_gaps_ms":stats(gaps),
      "DATA_completion_gaps_ms":stats(framegaps),"nonzero_DATA_completion_gaps_ms":stats([g for g in framegaps if g>0]),
      "same_read_adjacent_DATA":sum(g==0 for g in framegaps),"DATA_per_nonempty_read":dist(c["data_frames"] for c in reads),
      "first_DATA_after_START_ACK_ms":(data[0]["stamp"]-start["stamp"])*1000,
      "first_DATA_to_last_DATA_ms":(data[-1]["stamp"]-data[0]["stamp"])*1000,
      "first_DATA_to_END_ms":(end["stamp"]-data[0]["stamp"])*1000,
      "first27_DATA_completion_span_ms":(first27[-1]["stamp"]-first27[0]["stamp"])*1000,
      "first27_DATA_positive_gaps_ms":stats([(b["stamp"]-a["stamp"])*1000 for a,b in zip(first27,first27[1:]) if b["stamp"]>a["stamp"]]),
      "end_before_STOP":analysis["END_before_STOP"],"unknown_produced_tail":analysis["unknown_produced_tail"],
      "host_peak_raw_items":receipt.get("before_stop",{}).get("peak_raw_items"),
      "host_max_service_gap_ms":receipt.get("before_stop",{}).get("max_service_gap_ms"),
      "host_callback_errors":receipt["callback_errors"],"offline_equality_already_verified":True}
    if label.startswith("I3"):
        diag=json.loads(sha(folder/"diagnostics-decoded.json"))
        result["diagnostics"]={k:diag["raw"][k] for k in ("flags","step_count","tx_count","poll_count","copy_count","queue_high_water","driver_observed_poll_gap_us","copy_max_us","step_body_max_cycles","step_gap_max_cycles","tx_max_cycles","first_acquisition_reason","first_adc_fault","first_local_error")}
        result["diagnostics"]["matching_nonce"]=diag["nonce_hex"]==analysis["nonce_hex"]
    else:result["diagnostics_excluded"]="I2 reused legacy136 belongs to50k; only delivery/wire evidence compared"
    if label=="I3_150k":
        result["DATA_completion_rows"]=[{"first_index":f["first_index"],"samples":f["samples"],"sequence":f["sequence"],"wire_bytes":f["wire_bytes"],"host_since_START_ACK_ms":(f["stamp"]-start["stamp"])*1000,"read_bytes":chunks[f["chunk"]]["bytes"],"read_chunk":f["chunk"]} for f in data]
    out[label]=result
for rel in ("host/tools/v2_stream_probe.py","host/motortester/stream_controller.py","host/motortester/v2/stream_device.py",".venv/Lib/site-packages/serial/serialwin32.py","build/v6i-fw-01/patched/v2/app/mt_live_runtime.c","build/v6i-fw-01/patched/v2/protocol/mt_live_device.c","build/v6i-fw-01/patched/v2/protocol/mt_wire.c"):
    sha(ROOT/rel)
for rel,record in files.items():assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==record["sha256"]
print(json.dumps({"trials":out,"source_files":files,"originals_unchanged":True},ensure_ascii=False))

limits: I3 physical150k remains FAIL;100k PASS applies to saved5s trial only.
All compared END records retain produced_end unknown; matching bytes do not prove zero losses.
150k retains10MSB of ADC12; the discarded2LSBs cannot be reconstructed.
I2/100k legacy136 intentionally excluded because it belongs to preceding50k boot attempt.
This author analysis is not the independent critic's acceptance.
